name: coop-p2-rupee-pickup
expected: The title/file-select timeline selects the existing save before pressing A (the default empty slot would open name entry).
The title/file-select timeline loads the existing save or checkpoint.
P2 Start creates the dog after gameplay begins.
The dog traverses the seeded area without a runtime fault.
The probe emits wallet, wallet_capacity, rupees_collected, last_rupee_value, and nearby_rupees.
Before the pickup fix the dog records zero rupees_collected; after the fix it collects a ground rupee and the wallet delta matches the denomination.
